warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Charleville, Quilpie, Windorah, Mt Howitt Station, Injune and Tambo.
